in_marathi.name: Atikul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atikul हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Atikul is derived from Sanskrit roots 'ati' meaning ancient and 'kul' meaning family or race. This name is often given to a boy who is considered wise and knowledgeable, an ancient soul who carries deep wisdom and understanding.
